# What would selling your losers save in tax?

> Free tax-loss harvesting calculator. Enter your realized gains, carried-forward losses and the positions you could sell at a loss to see the tax saved this year, the $3,000 ordinary deduction, the carryforward and wash-sale risk. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
